verdict.rationale: Docs gesture at general issue/project organization (github-docs-8, github-docs-12) but never mention milestones, time tracking, or issue dependencies explicitly — GitHub Issues does support milestones and task-list style linking but the evidence pack provides no confirmation of these specific capabilities, and time tracking is not a native GitHub feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of milestones, native time tracking, and issue dependency linking.
